roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Heart Health
roles.location: Remote - Boston, Massachusetts; Remote - New York, New York

bullets: Partner closely with Science and Engineering teams to define and deliver next-generation heart health sensing and signal analysis capabilities
Translate scientific findings and physiological concepts into intuitive, meaningful product experiences that empower members to better understand their heart health
Support discovery and development of new features spanning both wellness and regulated use cases
Contribute to the prioritization and delivery of roadmap initiatives, balancing scientific feasibility, user impact, and business opportunity
Partner with Design to create user experiences that communicate complex heart health data with simplicity and empathy
Product Ownership: take ownership of a hardware product to maximize company impact and customer satisfaction by solving customer and business pain points
Storytelling: Craft a unique product story rooted in deep customer insights.
Problem Solving: Proactively identify and resolve product-related issues throughout the product lifecycle.
Market & User Research: conduct market research, competitive analysis, and qualitative and quantitative user studies
Requirements Management: Write and manage product requirements (PRD), regularly assess progress, and facilitate timely decision making
